Done. Working tree has only untracked QA artifacts — no code changes, so no commit (charter commits only fixes).

## Run 63 — s1 api-test complete

**I closed Run 62's #1 carried gap.** All five `.qa-*.mjs` harnesses were re-run and — unlike last run, which lost every results file to `max_turns` — their pass/fail output is **persisted** to `C:\tmp\api-test-results.txt`. I wrote it incrementally after each phase, which was the explicit infra recommendation from last run.

| Harness | Result |
|---|---|
| `.qa-inventory.mjs` | 272 routes / 36 modules |
| `.qa-write-validation.mjs` | 164 requests, **0 5xx** |
| `.qa-crud-lifecycle.mjs` | 150 checks, **0 5xx** |
| `.qa-crud-part2.mjs` | 27 checks, **0 5xx** |
| `.qa-subactions.mjs` | 88 checks, **0 5xx** |

**~470 requests · 429 asserted checks · 0 unintentional 5xx · 0 real bugs.** Build exit 0, 8.39s.

**The blocker worth recording:** the harnesses read the token from `C:/tmp/qa-token.txt`, not the `server/.qa-token.txt` that memory documents. Every route returned 401 until I copied it across — likely why last run never got usable output.

**13 harness "failures", zero defects.** I chased each to root cause rather than filing them:
- `DELETE /crm/tasks|work-orders|canvass-pins/:id` → 404 because **those routes were never implemented** (the 404 body carries a `path` field — app-level catch-all, not a handler 404). The client never calls them. Adding them would be a new endpoint, out of charter.
- `completed → undefined` — the service maps `completed` to `completed_at`; there is no `completed` column.
- The 4 subaction 404s were wrong-path guesses; I verified each real path returns 200.

I paid particular attention to the **five empty-body writes returning 200**, since that's the exact shape of Run 62's two real bugs. I read each handler rather than assuming: all five are genuinely guarded (`PUT /alerts/config` short-circuits with no write; the others COALESCE). A live re-check confirmed alert config was untouched.

**One real problem found and fixed — in the data, not the code.** Prior harnesses created rows on tables with no DELETE route, so QA data had been accumulating in the live Neon free-tier DB and was **user-visible**: a `qa20260730 wo` work order was sitting in the real Work Orders list. I removed 27 rows scoped to the `qa2026` pattern and re-verified the affected endpoints. This will recur every run the CRUD harnesses execute — I flagged that in the resume.

Backend is now 22 runs at zero fixes. **#1 gap for next run: browser back/forward, untested for the fourth consecutive run.** Both `overnight_resume.md` and `MEMORY.md` are updated.
